globalGuardrails: The 13 secondary grayscale front candidates do not close canonical fidelity, colors, hidden surfaces, runtime integration or art review.
50 is a number of named remaining targets, not an established number of required PNGs. Exact image requirement remains null.
Pilot, Mad and Bionic are head designs, excluded from biomask generation.
Golden Angel requires two distinct masks; Afghanistan requires two states; Pirate contains separate components.
No source website was fetched or image inspected in this scope audit; designated reference agents own fresh retrieval.
Network runtime observed revision 5 is configuration evidence; network_policy.state remained unknown, so reachability must be established by actual requests.
Do not infer the missing body of MK-37 through MK-45 from the 13 class names; no invented numbering.
